corrections.claim: The Tokyo ⇄ Yamagata Shinkansen round trip is a per-person, per-trip budget line — the guide's Day 1 opens on this train, and the budget carried no line for it.
The Shinkansen round trip is a once-per-trip cost, not a per-day one — it must not multiply by the budget block's days: 4.
Tokyo→Yamagata one-way in an ordinary reserved car is ¥11,450 (¥6,050 運賃 + ¥5,400 指定席特急料金), so the round trip is ¥22,900 per person.

corrections.correctedValue: ≈¥11,450 each way in an ordinary reserved car (¥6,050 base fare + ¥5,400 express charge). Every Tsubasa seat is reserved — book all 8 together. ⚠ Confirm the exact figure at booking
corrections.claim: Fare breakdown ¥6,050 + ¥5,400 = ¥11,450 one way, and the Yamagata Shinkansen is all-reserved (「山形新幹線は全車指定席です。自由席はありません」); the figure carries the same ⚠ confirm-at-booking hedge the Plan and Transit surfaces already carry, because JR East's own fare page is unreachable.
The ¥11,450 fare is a single adult ticket, so the budget line is per person, matching every other item in this block.
The fare page this budget line rests on — the same citation the Plan and Transit surfaces already use for ≈¥11,450.
The fare page was re-fetched by this critic pass on 2026-08-28 and still publishes ¥6,050 + ¥5,400.
A rail fare is a transit fact (90-day shelf life per src/lib/staleness.ts), not a venue or default one.

corrections.previousValue:
Risshaku-ji (山寺) is reached by a direct ≈20-minute Senzan Line train from Yamagata. Admission is {{fact:yamadera-admission-500-yen}}, cash only.

⚠ The temple's own hours table publishes 8:00-16:00 for April-September and 8:30-15:00 for December-March, and nothing for October. Plan on a mid-afternoon close and confirm the day's closing time before setting out — there is no late climb here.

There is no cable car, ropeway, or shortcut anywhere on the mountain — the only way up to the Godaido viewing platform and Okunoin is on foot, via roughly 1,015 stone steps (figures vary 1,015-1,070 depending on the source), and there are no ramps or elevators anywhere on the site, including at the base.

Konponchudo, the main hall about 3 minutes' walk from the base entrance, is a genuinely worthwhile stop on its own without climbing further — the honest option for anyone who'd rather not attempt the stairs.

Lunch: Takifudo Namasoba, ≈7 min from the station near the mountain entrance, open 11:00-15:30. ⚠ Its seat counts appear only in restaurant directories, so phone 023-695-2039 ahead to hold a table for 8.

10:00-14:00 is when tour groups arrive and the paths and Godaido platform get genuinely crowded, worse still once koyo (autumn foliage) season builds — which is also the window the soba shop opens into. Climb early, eat after.

Taimenseki, right at the station, is a smaller, quicker soba stop for anyone splitting off from the group lunch or catching an earlier train.

Dinner back in the city: Inokoya Yamagatada, one minute from Yamagata Station inside the directly connected Kajo Central building, serves imoni — Yamagata's taro-and-beef stew — in individual mini-hearth pots, 17:00-22:00 daily, year-round (last order 21:00). It's walk-in, and its private rooms seat only 4-6, so eight people split across tables rather than sitting as a block; after 1,015 steps, the short covered walk is worth more than the private room. Phone 023-647-0655 to warn them a party of eight is coming.
corrections.claim: Inokoya Yamagatada is 「JR山形駅直結」 ≈1 minute from Yamagata Station in 霞城セントラル1F, serves imoni in individual 囲炉裏 pots, opens 「年中無休 17:00～22:00（L.O 21:00）」, and its telephone is 023-647-0655 — placed as Day 2's evening meal, the one evening the itinerary left without a food pick.

corrections.correctedValue: 1-1-1 Jonan-cho, Yamagata (Kajo Central Building 1F, 山形市城南町1-1-1 霞城セントラル1F)
corrections.claim: The venue's own site publishes 〒990-8580 山形県山形市城南町1-1-1 霞城セントラル1F — the item shipped with no address at all, failing the 4-question venue rule's "where".
The venue's own site publishes 023-647-0655 — the number a party of eight needs even at a walk-in venue whose rooms seat only 4-6.
The venue's own site publishes 「年中無休　17:00～22:00（L.O 21:00）」 — the last order was missing, and it is what decides whether a party of eight arriving off the Yamadera train can still be seated.

corrections.correctedValue: 1 min from Yamagata Station via the directly connected Kajo Central building
corrections.claim: The venue's own site describes the approach as ≈1 minute from JR Yamagata Station through a directly connected building (霞城セントラル) — an indoor, weather-independent approach, which is a material detail for the party's two low-mobility travellers in late October.
